title: AI Ethics & Bias — Measure Intersections and Feedback
key_insight: Audit intersectional slices where sample size permits and report uncertainty. Qualitative reports can surface harms missing from the table.
body:
## Measure Intersections and Feedback

Results look fair by gender and by region separately, yet one gender-region intersection receives poor service. Broad groups hide smaller harms.

Audit intersectional slices where sample size permits and report uncertainty. Qualitative reports can surface harms missing from the table.

Watch feedback loops: predictions change opportunities, and those changed outcomes become future training data.
common_mistakes: High average accuracy proves equal treatment.
Historical labels are always neutral truth.
Writing a broad value statement completes governance.
mini_exercise: Draw “Measure Intersections and Feedback” as three labeled steps, then explain the decision at each step.
real_world_usage: AI systems affect people through data collection, ranking, access, and automated decisions.
explain_back_prompt: Using “Measure Intersections and Feedback,” explain AI Ethics & Bias without assuming the listener knows AI engineering.
